en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Safwan, from Al Kahily who said,
‘I asked himasws about the Tayammum. So heasws struck with hisasws hand upon the rug, and heasws wiped hisasws face with it. Then heasws wiped his wrists, one of them upon the back of the other’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Safwan from al-Kahiliy who has said the following: “
I once asked him (the Imam) about Tayammum. He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, thumped his hand on the furnishing, then wiped with it his face and then the backs of his both hands one with the other.”
